purpose: 摄影杂志封面默认艺术指导；用户指定优先。
medium: Immersive editorial photography or explicitly identified photorealistic concept artwork; tactile detail, credible light and spatial depth.
identity: A designed original masthead, a distinct short topic headline and one primary visual focus. The publication name belongs to THIS issue, never inherited from a sample.
type: For Chinese geography/culture begin by testing substantial Song/Mincho serif display lettering, deliberate stroke contrast and optical spacing. A subject-led bold sans is allowed. Interior font roles do not automatically define the cover.
layering: Image shapes, title and genuine foreground form a deliberate relationship. Occlusion is optional, supported by a real/illustrated contour, and keeps all characters recognizable.
frame: Respect a requested continuous frame/color; otherwise select from this issue. Golden sample frames are not universal.
composition: Subject scale, crop, distinct planes and eye path must be deliberate. Derive headline placement from the image.
avoid: Flat geometric placeholders as photographic art direction
Detached title cards as the default cover
Copying sample masthead, green panel, mountain polygons or title positions
Automatic decorative English, fake barcode or issue number
Arbitrary polygons presented as extracted photographic contours
Plastic HDR texture, uniform oversharpening, unrelated cinematic props
